tools.name: desktop.observe

includeUiState.description: For a window, include a complete bounded control-state snapshot; requires independent explicit UIA read authority.

sinceObservationId.description: For the same window, return cumulative changes since this server-lifetime full observation baseline.

tools.description: Capture current desktop, monitor, or authorized window pixels and physical-coordinate metadata; optionally return bounded window changes since an authorized baseline.

tools.name: desktop.get_state
tools.description: Read current desktop-control state and metadata without returning image bytes. Reports private-human status and bounded content-free operation certainty for this server lifetime; unknown prior-server operations require fresh reconciliation, never replay.

tools.name: desktop.windows
tools.description: List currently authorized top-level Windows windows with session-scoped IDs and policy-relevant metadata; this privacy-filtered, non-prompting surface is not exhaustive application discovery and may be empty before Read/View approval.

tools.name: desktop.ui_tree
tools.description: Read a bounded Windows UI Automation tree for an authorized window.

tools.name: desktop.find_ui
tools.description: Find bounded Windows UI Automation elements in an authorized window by semantic properties.

tools.name: desktop.capabilities
tools.description: Inspect bounded current capability admission for one authorized window and optionally one uniquely resolved query or exact server-lifetime elementId. No prompt, UI mutation, permission grant, sensitive readback, or target reacquisition occurs. eligible is current prerequisite evidence, not an execution reservation; conditional operations still require action-specific and last-moment dispatch guards. Unsupported, prerequisite, authorization and evidence failures stay distinct.

tools.name: desktop.focus_window
tools.description: Explicitly prepare an exact authorized foreground-input target: restore if minimized, request Windows activation once, and verify foreground, active window and keyboard focus. Reports partial effects and precise refusal; does not grant input authority or bypass Windows restrictions.

tools.name: desktop.set_window
tools.description: Move, resize, minimize, maximize, or restore an authorized top-level window.

tools.name: desktop.move_pointer
tools.description: Move the physical Windows pointer to a desktop or observation-relative point without clicking.

tools.name: desktop.click
tools.description: Issue an authorized physical mouse click at a desktop or observation-relative point.

tools.name: desktop.drag
tools.description: Issue an authorized physical mouse drag between two points with balanced button state.

tools.name: desktop.scroll
tools.description: Issue authorized physical mouse wheel scrolling at a target point; every non-zero delta produces at least one effective Windows wheel step.

tools.name: desktop.type_text
tools.description: Inject Unicode text into the currently authorized foreground application without logging the text.

tools.name: desktop.key
tools.description: Press, hold, or release one normalized keyboard key in the currently authorized foreground application.

tools.name: desktop.hotkey
tools.description: Press an ordered keyboard combination and release it in reverse order in the authorized foreground application.

tools.name: desktop.activate_ui
tools.description: Exact provider-backed semantic action on an independently authorized element. New expand/collapse, set_range_value and scroll_into_view require explicit UI-read ALLOW for bounded state verification; no generic background guarantee. Returns dispatch/effect certainty, never retry authority.

tools.name: desktop.interact
tools.description: Set one control value using exactly one same-window query or server-lifetime elementId. Required background_only never uses physical input. Explicit background_first prefers native Win32 Edit; only proven pre-dispatch background ineligibility may use an exact-control WPF TextBox click/select-all/Unicode replacement with independent pointer/keyboard authority and explicit UI-read ALLOW. Physical fallback may change foreground/cursor. Exact-value evidence proves current state, not causal success. No retry or strategy switch after possible dispatch; human priority, bounded pause and unsafe-resume guards remain in force. Receipts expose selected strategy and ordered physical steps without raw values.

tools.name: desktop.wait
tools.description: Wait for a bounded duration without changing desktop state; MCP request cancellation or Stop interrupts the wait.

tools.name: desktop.wait_for

threshold.description: Inclusive minimum fraction of physical pixels with different decoded BGRA values in compatible captures. Zero is invalid; omitted uses 0.02.

stableForMs.description: Minimum sampled quiet interval after a fresh complete sample. Any observed pixel or supported UI-state change resets it; requires an includeUiState window baseline and independent observation/UI-read authority.

tools.description: Wait for a bounded window, UI state, screen change or observation_stable condition. element_gone initially admits one live exact elementId and proves its absence from a complete authorized ControlView sample inside the still-live bound window; ui_gone remains query-empty. observation_stable compares successive complete compatible pixel/UI samples for stableForMs, not semantic readiness or future stability. Typed-state waits select exactly one same-window query or server-lifetime elementId. UI waits require explicit UI-read ALLOW; observation_stable also requires independently authorized capture. Guarded waits return matched/timed_out/unavailable/interrupted and never acquire physical input. any_of races 2–8 guarded UI/exact-window-disappearance conditions under one deadline in round-robin order; first observed match wins (array order breaks a simultaneous match), unavailable admission/evidence terminates, and unsampled losing work never starts.

tools.name: desktop.applications
tools.description: Discover a bounded set of installed or running GUI applications with opaque session-bound identity references; inspect truncated and retry with an adequate supported limit when the desired application is absent, and do not treat a truncated result as exhaustive.

tools.name: desktop.resolve_application_window
tools.description: Privately resolve usable top-level windows for one exact running application reference or process instance, authorize observe_window, and return one selected window or authorized opaque candidates without using broad window enumeration.

tools.name: desktop.set_application_allow
tools.description: After protected local confirmation, persist or remove one application-scoped V3 ALLOW override. The server derives an exact AUMID for packaged apps or an exact Win32 .exe basename for Win32 apps; filename ALLOW applies to any Win32 executable with that exact name regardless of location or binary contents. Callers cannot provide policy identity, paths, hashes, filenames, AUMIDs, PIDs, or policy fragments. Desktop / All screens is intentionally excluded.

tools.name: desktop.launch_application
tools.description: Launch a resolved authorized application without accepting a command, path, arguments, environment, or elevation request.

tools.name: desktop.activate_application
tools.description: Restore if minimized and prepare the uniquely owned live window of an authorized application; verify actual foreground, active window and keyboard focus. Windows restrictions remain binding; preparation grants no input authority.

tools.name: desktop.wait_application
tools.description: Wait a bounded time for a usable window owned by a resolved application.

tools.name: desktop.close_application
tools.description: Request graceful close only for a currently owned resolved authorized application window.

tools.name: desktop.act
tools.description: Execute a bounded ordered move/click/double_click/drag/scroll/keypress/type/wait batch inside one authorized window. Human input pauses safe-boundary work by default: 1000ms quiet with no human-held input, at most 30000ms cumulative pause. Partial mutations never replay; after a pause only revalidated move/wait can continue without a control/caret oracle. Duration waits keep their wall-clock deadline. Optional per-action ui_exists query or UIA value/toggle/selection postconditions (exactly one query or server-lifetime elementId) require explicit Read / View ALLOW before any mutation. Value comparison is exact and protected values are rejected. verified means the predicate was observed, not causal/business success. Only genuine human interruption with proven owned-input cleanup and a matched ui_value_equals/ui_toggle_state/ui_selection_state predicate permits recovery advancement; execution stays uncertain and the next action still requires fresh safety revalidation. ui_exists cannot permit recovery. All other uncertain execution and unresolved verification stop later actions; no replay is authorized. finalObservation is opt-in and separately Read / View authorized. Canonical guarded physical/visual coordinator: optional per-pointer-action frameObservationId requires observation-local points and fresh identical same-window pixels before first dispatch. Optional postStateSinceObservationId returns separately authorized incremental post-state instead of a full final image; neither image nor delta proves intended effect.

tools.name: desktop.run

arguments.description: The ordinary arguments of desktop.<tool>; that canonical tool schema and runtime parser remain authoritative. No script or generated argument substitution.

tools.description: Canonical finite desktop sequence: 1–16 explicit observe/capabilities/interact/activate_ui/act/wait_for calls, up to 60 seconds and 256 KiB structured receipts. Each step independently uses normal authorization/admission; terminal failure or possible side-effect uncertainty stops later steps. No script, loop, retry, target substitution or transferable approval. Current observation references/post-state are returned without redundant image transfer; request desktop.observe explicitly when an image is needed. Entire input is bounded to 64 KiB UTF-8.

tools.name: desktop.human_control
tools.description: Enter explicit private human control across participating current-user/logon-session servers. Agent reads/input are blocked and queues drained before successful protection acknowledgement. Resume needs protected local human confirmation, invalidates old evidence and requires a fresh authorized observation before mutation. Stop remains terminal. Does not protect older non-participating installed runtimes or grant application authority.

tools.name: desktop.stop
tools.description: Only for an explicit operator-requested global input stop: latch this server session into input-stopped state and release server-held input. Not normal cleanup, focus reset, or task completion.
